title: Quick American Pico Tacos
description: Fresh, fluffy, indulgent american dish featuring pico de gallo sauce, served in a salt-block vessel, made jain-friendly by substituting animal products with plant-based alternatives,

ingredients.name: tandoor chicken
ingredients.notes: substituted with plant-based tandoor chickpea alternative for jain recipe.

ingredients.name: plant-based sour cream
ingredients.notes: jain alternative to traditional sour cream.

ingredients.name: cauliflower rice
ingredients.notes: optional, used to make tacos more filling.

instructions: Preheat the tandoor to 200°C for 10 minutes before using it to cook the plant-based tandoor chickpea alternative.
Season the plant-based tandoor chickpea alternative with cumin, salt, and black pepper before placing it in the preheated tandoor to cook for 10 minutes at 200°C.
Prepare the pico de gallo sauce by finely chopping the fresh onion, fresh tomato, and fresh cilantro and combining them in a bowl with lime juice.
Chop the avocado into small pieces and set it aside for topping the tacos later.
Heat the pico de gallo sauce in a pan over medium heat for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Warm the corn tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.

Assemble the tacos by placing a few pieces of the cooked plant-based tandoor chickpea alternative onto a corn tortilla, followed by a spoonful of the heated pico de gallo sauce, a sprinkle of cauliflower rice, and a dollop of plant-based sour cream.
Top the tacos with chopped avocado, a sprinkle of cilantro, and a few chipotle peppers for added flavor.
Serve the tacos immediately and enjoy!
